character_facts: Steelhead is capable of stealth infiltration and bypassing defenses with ease.
Steelhead is accused on this page of killing Nacnor Rosaamel de Rokha.
The robotic speakers are emotionally invested in Steelhead's actions and in the honor of the Metabarons/Castakas lineage.
characters_present: Steelhead (not directly seen clearly, identified by narration)
Two robotic or cybernetic speakers inside the opening panels
continuity_links: Steelhead is linked to the Metabarons and specifically to the Castakas clan through the speakers' condemnation.
The page connects Steelhead's current infiltration to an earlier killing of Nacnor Rosaamel de Rokha.
dialogue_meaning: The speakers report that Steelhead has breached a defense system using a cloaked craft.
One speaker accuses Steelhead of murdering Nacnor Rosaamel de Rokha, described as the last planar Tay priest tied to traditional ecology.
The exchange frames Steelhead's behavior as dishonorable and disgraceful to the Metabarons and Castakas legacy.
The conversation becomes openly hostile, with one speaker threatening violence if interrupted or judged.
locations: A metallic interior or communications setting with robotic figures
Philodendra, identified as the capital planet
Airspace above villages and non-artificial forests
lore_facts: Steelhead uses a 'poly-cloaked psy-glider' for stealthy penetration.
There exists a Troglosocialik line or system of defense.
Nacnor Rosaamel de Rokha is identified as the last planar Tay priest associated with preserving traditional ecology.
Philodendra is identified as the capital planet.
The region below includes villages harmonized with non-artificial forests.
The defensive line Steelhead crosses is described as outdated.
plot_events: Steelhead infiltrates the Troglosocialik defense system while flying a poly-cloaked psy-glider.
Two robotic figures discuss and condemn Steelhead's actions in heated, insulting terms.
The narration shifts to an exterior approach over the capital planet's landscape under several moons.
Steelhead passes above villages blended with natural forest.
Steelhead penetrates an outdated defensive line with little difficulty.
uncertainties: Some dialogue is small and partially difficult to read; exact spellings of names and terms such as 'Troglosocialik' and 'Nacnor Rosaamel de Rokha' may be imperfect.
The robotic speakers are not named on the page.
Steelhead is identified by captions, but the craft/pilot is not shown in a clearly character-identifiable close-up.
visual_summary: A sequence of narrow panels shows robots or machine beings in conversation inside a metallic setting, followed by wide exterior views of a starry planetary landscape with multiple moons. Captions describe Steelhead infiltrating a defensive system in a camouflaged psy-glider and flying over villages and forested terrain toward the capital world.
